verdicts.why: Marvel DB: the first Six 'disbanded' after S2E2 and the Kingpin's re-formed Six disbanded at the end of S5E6; Ock then serves the Red Skull on Battleworld, not a group. Both endings are group ends, so Independent after each and a left entry are right.

Marvel DB: the six disbanded after S2E1-2; he later works for Richard Fisk/the Kingpin; the other five break him out to re-form the Six (S5), and he then betrays them to the Red Skull. The record misses the first disbanding and the rejoin.

Marvel DB: Otto worked at Tricorp before, then came to work for Osborn at Oscorp; after the ep 8 accident he turns on Osborn and in ep 8 only breaks into Tricorp to steal the Megalopack; he then forms the Sinister Six. Order Tricorp, Oscorp, Sinister Six.

Marvel DB: WWI U.S. soldier in backstory; sprung by Silvermane (ep 5) and joins his crime ring; still fighting the Spider for him when killed in ep 8. Affiliation 'Silvermane's Crime Ring, formerly U.S. Army'.
He never leaves Silvermane: he dies in ep 8 while fighting the Spider in Silvermane's service; death is not a departure.
Marvel DB: Montana starts in the Enforcers, joins the Sinister Six, later rejoins Fancy Dan and Ox as the New Enforcers; affiliation 'The Enforcers, formerly Sinister Six'.

Marvel DB: after the Chameleon's betrayal 'the Shocker and rest of the Insidious Six decided to disband' (S5E2-6). The departure is real, but the groups must also end in an Independent stage so the last stage matches the left entry.

Marvel DB: the re-formed Six 'disbanded once they realized that there was no profit to be made' (S5E6); team Defunct. Departure is real; the groups also need a closing Independent stage to match the left entry.

Marvel DB: Scorpion was in the first Six (S2E1-2, which disbanded), later tried to go straight, then was again in the Kingpin's Six for the Doomsday hunt (S5E2-6), which disbanded; affiliation 'Formerly: Insidious Six'. The groups need Independent stages (titled, not '(from the start)') to match the left entry.

Marvel DB: the team 'failed to destroy Spider-Man and disbanded to avoid arrest' (S2E2); he never rejoins and is replaced by the Vulture. The groups need a closing Independent stage (titled) to match the left entry.

Wikipedia/Marvel DB: Strickland oversees Imperium at Area 51 for the whole film and dies there; nothing on screen moves him out and back. (He is an Army general, but that is not a separate on-screen move.)
Marvel DB: Army service is WWI backstory; he joins Silvermane (ep 5), and after the antidote cures him (ep 7) he 'abandoned Silvermane' and left New York. No return to the Army.
Marvel DB: the Vulture joined the Six only in S5E2, replacing Mysterio, and 'the team disbanded' in S5E6; in his earlier episodes he is in no group.
Marvel DB: 'The team disbanded as Electro attacked New York' (S5E6); the group ends, so a left entry for Spider-Man (1994) is right (with the closing Independent stage from the G1 item).
Marvel DB: Black Widow (Earth-92131) is 'a member of the Avengers' who accompanies Captain America to give Wolverine the Weapon X intel (X-Men '97 S2E4); affiliation Avengers.
The X-Men '97 Gambit is Remy LeBeau (Earth-92131) on Marvel DB, as is his twin A:fox-anim-gambit; null (Earth-199999) is wrong.
The animated series' Phoenix is filed as Phoenix Force (Earth-92131), bonded to Jean Grey (Earth-92131); null (Earth-199999) is wrong.
Marvel DB: the Void Gambit of Deadpool & Wolverine is Remy LeBeau, Reality TRN1401, pruned by the TVA; other Void resistance members in the data use their Marvel DB Earths.
The record covers X-Men: The Last Stand and the new 2023 of DoFP, both Earth-10005 under the owner's rule; twin A:fox-jean-grey is Earth-10005.
The record covers Dark Phoenix only, which is Earth-TRN414 under the owner's rule; twin A:fox-jean-grey-young is Earth-TRN414.

His record spans First Class, DoFP's 1973 and Apocalypse (where he dies), the young cast's timeline; every other young-cast record that runs into Apocalypse (young Charles, young Beast, Raven, Erik, young Moira) is filed Earth-TRN414 under the owner's rule. Marvel DB itself has no TRN414 page and keeps him at Earth-10005, so this follows the owner's rule, not the wiki.
